basics.name: Giancarlo Papa
basics.label: Senior Full Stack Engineer – Cloud Platform & AI Engineering
basics.summary: Senior Full-Stack Engineer with 25 years of PHP expertise and deep command of the modern web stack — from Symfony and Laravel to Vue.js, Nuxt, and headless CMS platforms including WordPress, Joomla, Craft CMS, and Shopware. Experienced in Python across data warehouse engineering, FastAPI service development, and automation; grounded in Linux server operations, Docker containerisation, and cloud-native infrastructure on GCP. I design, build, and own business-critical internal platforms — Salesforce DevOps, enterprise integrations, and applied AI systems (Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini) — with 13+ years of platform ownership in a demanding Swiss telecommunications environment.
basics.summaryPdf: I am a self-taught web artisan, coding since eleven (BASIC on a C64). I design and build robust, scalable web platforms with clean architecture, driven by curiosity and a strong commitment to open source. I have delivered high-traffic public platforms in Italy and business-critical enterprise software in the Swiss telecom sector. As Tech Lead for the OMNI Channel Platforms unit at Sunrise, I take end-to-end technical ownership: architecture and technology decisions, REST/API design and system integration, engineering standards, and reliable DevOps operations. I lead hands-on, enforce best practices, and build systems that last.

coreCompetencies.proof: 25 years PHP — built AMP platform (Laravel/Vue.js) running 7+ years in production at Sunrise
Led LAMP → Docker/GCP migration — GitLab CI pipelines, containerised deployments on RHEL
Built Jordan AI (Liberty Global) — Python/FastAPI + Azure OpenAI for real-time call assistance at scale
13+ years Tech Lead OMNI Channel Platform — architecture decisions, roadmaps, engineering standards
CI/CD pipelines, Apex/LWC development, API integrations, enterprise data sync at Sunrise

work.name: Sunrise Communications AG
work.position: Tech Lead OMNI Channel Platforms & Senior Full Stack Engineer
work.summary: 13+ years of progressive ownership across full-stack development, Salesforce DevOps, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and applied AI at one of Switzerland's leading telecommunications companies.
highlights: Technical Lead for the OMNI Channel Platform: driving architectural decisions, establishing engineering standards, defining technical roadmaps, and serving as the primary technical reference for business stakeholders and engineering teams.
Designed and built scalable full-stack applications using PHP (Laravel), Vue.js, TypeScript, and REST APIs — deployed on GCP and Linux (RHEL) with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
Architected and owned AMP — a multilingual call-centre productivity suite (Laravel/Vue.js/Oracle/MySQL/Redis/Elasticsearch) — from design to production.
Salesforce DevOps Engineer: CI/CD pipelines, release management, custom Apex, LWC components, Flows, API integrations, and enterprise data sync.
Drove DevOps transformation: LAMP/LEMP to FrankenPHP on Docker/GCP/RHEL, GitLab CI/Jenkins pipelines, release automation.
Developed AMP (Laravel/Vue.js/Oracle/MySQL/Redis/Elasticsearch): call centre portal — ticket templates (4 langs), distribution, and feedback tools.

successStories.title: AMP Platform — Call Centre Backbone
successStories.shortForm: Replaced fragile legacy script with a full-stack call-centre platform (Laravel/Vue.js) — mission-critical for 7+ years across all Sunrise Customer Care.
successStories.challenge: Sunrise Customer Care relied on a fragile legacy PHP script that could not scale across languages or business units.
successStories.action: Architected and delivered AMP — a full-stack Laravel/Vue.js platform with a multilingual ticket engine (4 languages), automated distribution, and feedback tools, deployed on GCP with Docker and GitLab CI.
successStories.result: AMP became Sunrise's mission-critical call-centre platform, running reliably in production for 7+ years and supporting daily operations across the entire Customer Care organisation.

successStories.title: Jordan AI — Liberty Global
successStories.shortForm: Built AI-powered real-time call assistant (Python/FastAPI + Azure OpenAI) — deployed internationally across Liberty Global subsidiaries.
successStories.challenge: Call centre agents across Liberty Global subsidiaries had no real-time support during customer calls, slowing resolution times and degrading service quality.
successStories.action: Built Jordan AI — Python/FastAPI backend + Vue.js interface — integrating live call data with Azure OpenAI to generate real-time conversation pre-summaries and automated agent diagnostics.
successStories.result: Deployed internationally across Liberty Global subsidiaries, providing agents with real-time AI assistance during live calls.

successStories.title: DevOps Transformation
successStories.shortForm: Migrated from manual LAMP deployments to Docker/GCP/GitLab CI — release reliability improved, deployment frequency increased substantially.
successStories.challenge: Manual LAMP deployments were slow, error-prone, and blocked rapid iteration.
successStories.action: Led migration to Docker containers on GCP/RHEL with GitLab CI/Jenkins pipelines and automated release workflows.
successStories.result: Release reliability improved significantly and deployment frequency increased substantially.
